newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber unchanged in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber offer prices were unchanged in noon trading amid a lack of buying interest, traders said.
"There's no activity in the market yet. But I personally believe prices will trend downwards because of a lack of buying interest," said one trader.
Traders said the market did not anticipate much from the International Natural Rubber Organisation's (INRO) plan to resume market intervention to stabilise prices.

"It's a kind of premature to expect anything from this INRO plan. We'd better wait and see. The key issue in the local market now is the supply is tight because many tappers are looking elsewhere for work due to low prices," said another trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 46.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Palembang for August shipment, 47.25 fob Medan, 46.50 fob Padang and Surabaya and 46.50 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Some traders said many rubber collectors who source from tappers were hoarding stocks, waiting for better prices.
